author: Miranda Adams
title: Mental hospital director arrested in Visalia stabbing - NewsBreak
text:
By Miranda Adams ,
1 hours ago
COALINGA, Calif. ( KSEE/KGPE ) – The suspect accused of stabbing a man in Visalia last Thursday is a mental hospital program director, his employers confirmed.
In a Tuesday email to YourCentralValley.com, the Department of State Hospitals (DSH) confirmed Ian Young has been employed by DSH since 2011 and, at the time of his arrest, was serving as a Program Director at DSH-Coalinga.
According to police, that stabbing happened on Friday, Aug. 21, around 11 p.m., after Young got into an argument with a man in the 500 block of East Main Street.
By the time police arrived, neither Young nor the victim, who had already been taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening wounds, were there.
Young was later found and arrested in Coalinga on Aug. 27.
